name: Tour
description:
A guided tour of an application's UI. Each step dims the page except its target (the
spotlight, in the scrim colour) and shows a card anchored to it with an arrow: the
title, a sentence or two, "Step 2 of 5", Skip, Back and Next (Done on the last step).
Targets scroll into view, and the spotlight and card follow them through scrolling and
resizing. A step whose target is missing waits up to `targetTimeout`, then is skipped.

The card is a non-modal dialog named by its title: focus moves to it when the tour opens
and returns where it was when it closes, and nothing else on the page is made inert. ← and
→ step while focus is in the card; Esc skips. The spotlight is decorative. Still and
reduced motion move the spotlight without animating.
signature: ({ steps, open: openProp, defaultOpen, onOpenChange, step: stepProp, defaultStep, onStepChange, onComplete, onSkip, storageKey, targetTimeout, labels, locale, }: TourProps): import("react").JSX.Element | null

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Show the tour at first (uncontrolled). Ignored once `storageKey` records it as completed.

props.name: defaultStep
props.description: The step shown first when the step is uncontrolled. Default 0.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ progress: (step: number, total: number) => string; next: string; back: string; done: string; skip: string; announce: ({ step, total, title }: { step: number; total: number; title: string; }) => string; }> | undefined
props.description: Wording for this instance, over the language pack and `MessagesProvider`.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the wording. Default: the nearest `LocaleProvider`.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called when the person presses Done on the last step.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.type: ((open: boolean, details: { reason: TourCloseReason | "open"; }) => void) | undefined
props.description: Called with false and the reason when the tour finishes, is skipped or Esc closes it.

props.name: onSkip
props.description: Called with the step's index when the person skips the tour (Skip or Esc).

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Called with the step's index when Next, Back or the arrow keys change it, or a missing target is skipped.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the tour is showing. Controlled while defined.

props.name: step
props.description: The current step's index. Controlled while defined.

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps, in order. A step whose target is missing is skipped (after `targetTimeout`).

props.name: storageKey
props.description:
Remember completion in localStorage under this key: finishing or skipping records it, and
an uncontrolled tour does not open again. Include the user and the tour's version
("onboarding:v2:user-42"). `useTourCompletion` reads and resets it.

props.name: targetTimeout
props.description: How long to wait for a step's target to appear (ms) before skipping it. Default 1000.
